name: graphqlQuery
description: Rows returned by a Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics query you write, optionally for a chosen zone or account

JSON.parse(variables || '{}') : variables || {}; return Object.assign(fromTimeframe, fromTarget, own); })(((v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v))) }}

ui.name: query
ui.label: GraphQL query
ui.help: Declare any of these variables to use them: `$start` / `$end` (`Time!`) and `$startDate` / `$endDate` (`Date!`) from the timeframe (not sent with the **None** timeframe), and `$zoneTag`, `$zoneTags` (`[string!]`) and `$accountTag` (`string`) from the selected zone or account. Each dataset limits how wide a timeframe it accepts; a wider one fails with the limit named. See the [GraphQL Analytics docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/).

ui.name: variables
ui.label: Variables
ui.help: Extra variables as a JSON object, for example `{ "limit": 50 }`. A value here overrides the built-in variable of the same name.

ui.name: pathToData
ui.label: Path to rows
ui.help: Leave empty to use the first array of rows in the response. Set a dot path, such as `data.viewer.zones.0.httpRequests1hGroups`, when the query reads several datasets or zones.
